archive_title: OrbitFS Billing Store Email Templates Archive
archive_scope: Billing Store email templates only. No mailbox, transport, mail settings, inbound mail, queue, delivery log, or mail account configuration is included.

source.extraction: Live Supabase public.mail_templates and public.mail_automations rows.

templates.html:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Your OrbitFS Base payment has been activated and your licence key is ready.

Reveal your licence key

This link can reveal the key once and expires in {{expires_hours}} hours.

After the key activates an OrbitFS installation, that licence is bound to that one Base system and its add-ons until you unlock it.

Key rotations are shown directly when requested and are not emailed.
templates.name: OrbitFS licence key ready
templates.subject: Your OrbitFS licence key is ready
templates.text_body:
Hi {{customer_name}},

Your OrbitFS Base payment has been activated and your licence key is ready.

Reveal your licence key once: {{license_key_url}}

This link expires in {{expires_hours}} hours.

After activation the licence is bound to one Base system and its add-ons until unlocked. Key rotations are not emailed.
